name: Chambermaid
ability: Each night, choose 2 alive players (not yourself): you learn how many woke tonight due to their ability.
wakes: Every night, including the first, late in the night order. Not woken if fewer than 2 other living players can be chosen.
learns: A number 0, 1 or 2: how many of the chosen players woke tonight due to their own ability.
malfunction: Storyteller may give a false number from 0-2 (misinformation offered centrally).

jinxes.text: The Chambermaid can detect if the Mathematician will wake tonight.

rulings.text: Waking for other reasons does not count: Minion/Demon info, or being woken by another character's ability (e.g. a Shabaloth woken by the Exorcist).
A player who woke on an earlier night but not tonight is not counted.
Players who woke for their ability count even if they are drunk or poisoned.
A player who wakes but chooses not to act (e.g. Assassin) counts; an ability used without waking (e.g. Gossip) does not.
If a dead player is chosen, the Storyteller has the Chambermaid choose again.

tests.name: counts wakers
tests.setup: Alice Chambermaid, Bob Monk, Cara Fool, Dan Poisoner, Eve Imp. Night 2.
tests.actions: Bob protects Cara, Dan poisons Bob, Eve kills Cara; Alice chooses Bob and Dan.
tests.expected: Both woke due to their ability (Bob's counts though poisoned): Alice learns 2.

tests.name: first night minion info not counted
tests.setup: Alice Chambermaid, Bob Soldier, Cara Assassin, Dan Moonchild, Eve Imp. Night 1.
tests.expected: Cara woke only for Minion info, Dan never wakes: Alice learns 0.

tests.name: drunk chambermaid
tests.setup: Alice is the Drunk believing she is the Chambermaid; Bob Grandmother, Cara Goon, Dan Poisoner, Eve Imp. Night 2.
tests.actions: Alice chooses Bob and Cara; storyteller is offered 1 and 2 as misinformation and picks 2.

tests.name: woken by other ability not counted
tests.setup: Alice Chambermaid, Bob Exorcist, Cara Fool, Dan Witch, Eve Shabaloth. Night 2.
tests.actions: Bob chooses Eve and Eve is woken by the Exorcist; Alice chooses Eve and Cara.
tests.expected: Eve woke due to the Exorcist, not her own ability: Alice learns 0.

tests.name: mathematician jinx
tests.setup: Alice Chambermaid, Bob Mathematician, Cara Chef, Dan Poisoner, Eve Imp. Night 2.
tests.actions: Alice chooses Bob and Cara (Mathematician wakes after the Chambermaid).
tests.expected: Bob will wake tonight and counts: Alice learns 1.
